A '''crash wagon''' was a type of [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] [[Tractor/Legends|tractor]]. Employed in [[Hangar/Legends|hangar bays]], they were tasked with pushing or dragging damaged [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], equipment or munitions out of the docking bay to prevent them from causing further damage. Crash wagons were equipped with [[Blast shield/Legends|blast shields]], and were also used for above-ground excavation work, clearing fire zones and emplacement digging.<ref name="SWS" />
